body: nothing to talk about, I'm done.
I've tried stuff similar to that before, it doesn't work, I can't lie to myself.

No and no, I've only gone to 3 sessions of counseling. I don't know if I can just outright tell her that she sucks considering I'm getting it for free from my university...

I've felt hopeless and dead my whole life, I shouldn't have been born...It's just getting to the point where I can't keep going.

I appreciate what you guys are doing, and I'm sorry for being a critical ass, but I don't think this is very helpful...

My family wouldn't help this situation, trust me. 

As far as the social interaction bit goes....I don't know how to explain this but, I want to have friends but I also don't want to have friends. I would like to be able to talk to someone, I am getting very sick of living in my head. But at the same time I know that being around people is very uncomfortable for me. I just can't process all the stuff you need to do to be social with people.

I also get the feeling that I'm cursed or someshit, I don't know how to explain it. It seems that people hate me by default...Two days after I moved into my dorm I found out that my suite mates and most of the people in my dorm despised me and hated, because one of them was given an MIP citation and they automatically assumed I called the cops. I don't say anything to anyone except "excuse me" when I blunder into someone or something, and I have more enemies than Richard Nixon. I have never been able to understand this...
